posts.title: Archiving family photographs: a format statement
posts.description: What we capture when we scan a family photograph, what we keep, and how we expect it to still be readable in fifty years without any of the software that made it.

posts.title: GoNIX and gokrazy: two ways to run Go on bare Linux
posts.description: Both put a Go userland on top of the Linux kernel, but one wants to be a small UNIX you can read in an afternoon and the other wants to be an appliance with nothing you don’t need.
